[Equipment Option Change Item]

A device that forcibly changes the nature of the energy contained in Soul Weapons, Gear and accessories.
Using it changes the nature of the energy applied to each piece of equipment.
However, the more energy the equipment has, the more devices are needed.
The changed energy nature is set randomly, so use it with care.

It cannot be used once expired, so use it up within the period.

Using it changes the nature of the energy applied to each piece of equipment.

The changed energy nature is set randomly, so use it with care.

A device that prevents gear destruction when enhancing past a certain value.
It forcibly blocks the self-destruct signal triggered by an output abnormality, preventing destruction.
While item use is checked, 1 is consumed per enhancement whether or not destruction is prevented.

Unusable once expired, so use it within the period.
